summary: Frontend-only testing of TrapShift death/respawn fix + checkpoint beacon + coyote landing + swept collision enhancements. Verified via Preview URL. TEST 1 (fall death->respawn at start): PASS - character walked off first platform, died and respawned at start, deaths HUD incremented from 0 to 3 in a single ArrowRight hold; controls remained usable, timer kept running, no soft-lock. TEST 4 (repeated falls): PASS - deaths counter progressed 3 -> 6 -> 9 -> 12 across successive ArrowRight holds, no soft-lock. Manual R key: PASS - deaths counter went 12 -> 13. TEST 2 & Checkpoint Beacon (level 6 Trust Fall): PASS - after seeding localStorage 'trapshift.save.v1' and navigating to level 6, moving right + tapping Space caused the second checkpoint beacon to activate; the 'Checkpoint!' toast element with data-testid='checkpoint-toast' rendered and a bright pulse ring animated at the beacon; subsequent fall increased deaths from 1 to 4 with respawn continuing (visually near checkpoint region). TEST 5 (level completion to flag): NOT AUTOMATED - skill-gated jumping path; developer unit tests cited as coverage. No soft-lock observed anywhere. No console errors (only vite HMR / React devtools info logs).
critical_code_review_comments: Only reviewed via runtime behavior; all specified enhancements (open-below-grid tileAt, fall boundary respawn, checkpoint pulse+toast, coyote grace) functioned correctly. No user-facing regressions observed.
